evidence.detail: Preaggregation uses `(SELECT DISTINCT card, deck_id FROM deck_card)` — the `n` (copies) column is deliberately stripped, so avg copies is not computed
load_cards SELECT has no avg_copies column; the data doesn't reach the API
Header row has # Decks, Record, Win %, tournament wins, 5-0s — no avg copies column
deck_card table has `n INTEGER NOT NULL` per row — the raw data exists, just not aggregated

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/card.py: change `(SELECT DISTINCT card, deck_id FROM deck_card)` to `(SELECT card, deck_id, n FROM deck_card WHERE NOT sideboard)` in preaggregate_card and preaggregate_card_archetype; add `avg_copies FLOAT` column to those preaggregation table schemas; add `AVG(avg_copies)` in load_cards SELECT. In decksite/controllers/api.py: no change needed (camelized automatically). In shared_web/static/js/cardtable.jsx: add 'Avg Copies' th and td rendering card.avgCopies. ~4 files, ~30 lines total, no DB migration (preaggregation tables are recreated).
triage.notes: The comment filter (WHERE NOT sideboard) must be added because the existing DISTINCT was avoiding double-counting between maindeck and sideboard rows; without DISTINCT the sideboard filter serves the same purpose.
